annotations.title: Record rows of a declared format

description: Write rows into a declared format — **a list of them in one call**. The columns belong to the document — `start_here` lists them, `formats` in full — and a key the format has not got refuses the batch rather than being dropped, because a figure you believe you stored and did not is worse than one you know is missing. A `money` column takes the amount in major units beside its own `<column>_currency` key, and a `quantity` column takes the figure beside a `<column>_unit` key naming a unit this document knows — `amount: 200` with `amount_unit: ml`. A `link` takes the row’s id, its name (first text column) when one row has it — `recipe: "Pancakes"` — or columns that find one: `{name: "Salt", brand: "Fine"}`, or one unique column alone: `course: {notion_id: "a1b2"}`; a row may name another of the same batch. Types, bounds and enum members are checked before anything is written and the whole batch applies or none of it does. Returns the diff and writes nothing until `commit: true`.

commit.description: Write it. Omit or false for the dry run.
